protocol.label: M2 exploratory chronological protocol; M1 2024–2025 already examined
protocol.promotion: No automatic promotion; reserve a future period not inspected during development.

preprocessing: training-only mean imputation (all-empty=0), StandardScaler, L2 logistic C=1 max_iter=1000 seed=42
sigmoid: logit(p) logistic C=1e6 fitted only calibration year
interval_method: paired season-week cluster percentile bootstrap; unadjusted 95% intervals, no multiplicity correction; correlated weeks and few seasons limit inference
